headline: [Yemen War Shift!] Houthis Advance to [60 km] From Aden as Government Retreats
sub: Forces pull back from Bab el-Mandeb Strait
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Yemen War Shift! Houthis Advance to 60 km From Aden as Government Retreats

Yemen's Houthis have advanced to about 60 km (37 miles) from Aden, the temporary seat of Yemen's internationally recognised government, military and government sources told AFP on Sunday. Earlier the same day, Saudi-backed government forces said they were pulling out of areas near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to focus on defending Aden.

🔹 Sources say the Houthis seized two districts in Lahj province and reached the Al-Kharaz camp, where the UN refugee agency says 9,600 refugees are at risk.
🔹 The Houthis now say they hold more than 150 km of the Red Sea coast that government forces left. Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most important shipping routes.
🔹 Government forces have been building sandbag defences and digging tunnels around Aden. The UN says more than 1,600 people have been killed since fighting restarted in July.

💬 What do you think will happen next in Yemen? 👇

Sources: AFP, Reuters, Al Jazeera

headline: [Big Build-Up!] [Third US Aircraft Carrier] Reaches Middle East Amid Iran Tensions
sub: Iran says it will not wait to be attacked
caption:
⚓ Big Build-Up! Third US Aircraft Carrier Reaches Middle East Amid Iran Tensions

The US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike group have arrived in the Middle East, a US official told ABC News and Al Jazeera. It entered the area of US Central Command on Sunday, November 15.

🔹 The US now has three aircraft carriers in the region: the Roosevelt, the USS George H.W. Bush and the USS George Washington.
🔹 Late on Sunday, Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Tehran "will not wait for the US to attack first."
🔹 The move comes as tensions with Iran stay high and Donald Trump begins a trip to Asia this week, with Iran expected to be discussed at talks with China's Xi Jinping.

💬 What do you think this means for the region? 👇

Sources: ABC News, Al Jazeera, Axios

headline: [Perfect Debut!] Mirra Andreeva, 19, Wins [WTA Finals] Without Losing a Set
caption:
🏆 Perfect Debut! Mirra Andreeva, 19, Wins WTA Finals Without Losing a Set

Russia's Mirra Andreeva won the WTA Finals on Sunday, beating Ukraine's Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 in the final at Indian Wells, California. It was her first time playing at the season-ending event.

🔹 Andreeva, 19, won all five of her matches without dropping a set.
🔹 She takes home $3.37 million, the biggest possible prize at the event.
🔹 The win lifts her to a career-high world No. 2 in the rankings.

💬 Can Andreeva become world No. 1 next year? 👇

Sources: Reuters, AFP
